name: teapilot
description: Local and budgeted cloud agents, delegation tools, and models for VS Code chat.

chatParticipants.name: teapilot
chatParticipants.description: Use TeaPilot's own models, coding tools, approvals, and budgets.

commands.name: code
commands.description: Work in a selected local folder

languageModelTools.name: teapilot_ask
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delegate a bounded question to TeaPilot.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegate an independent question, explanation, or research task to TeaPilot. It uses separately configured local or paid models with its own budget. It cannot read repositories or execute commands. Pass all necessary context; it has no access to this conversation. Do not delegate recursively.

languageModelTools.name: teapilot_code
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delegate coding work; edits are applied directly.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegate one bounded coding task to TeaPilot's independent agent. It edits files directly and asks for shell approvals. Pass the full task and an open workspace folder's absolute path or name; it cannot access this conversation. Await completion and inspect its changed-file/check summary before further edits. Never invoke recursively.

workspace.description: Absolute path or name of an open local workspace folder

teapilot.nodePath.description: Installed Node.js >=22.19 executable. User setting only; never a shell command.

teapilot.webSearch.enabled.description: Enable configured SearXNG search for TeaPilot chat requests.
